Compare Two Transmission Scenarios

scenario_compare.Rd

This function compares two transmission scenarios by: 1. Combining case output data and generating comparative line and ribbon plots. 2. Producing summary statistics including peak and total cases. 3. Generating cumulative case trajectories. 4. Comparing susceptible proportions over time between the scenarios.

Usage

scenario_compare(scenario_1, scenario_2)

Arguments

scenario_1

A named list of outputs from scenario 1, including: - `select_state_plot$data`: Time-series summary data (`data.table`) - `box_data`: Peak/total case data by `run` - `cumulative_case_plot$data`: Cumulative case trajectories - `susceptibility_data`: Long-format susceptibility proportions by time

scenario_2

Same structure as `scenario_1`, for the second scenario.

Value

A named list containing:

summary_plot

A combined patchwork plot of all summary graphics.

summary_table

A formatted `gt` table of case summary statistics.

individual_plots

A list of individual `ggplot2` plots for further use.
